other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via original dataset inclusion
other_failure_modes.description: Appending the original dataset to the training fold during cross-validation without removing duplicates. Because synthetic datasets often contain exact or near-exact copies of the original dataset, samples in the validation fold are identical to those in the appended original dataset, causing severe target leakage and artificially perfect validation scores.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated solution with excellent feature engineering, deep learning integration, and advanced ensembling. However, it suffers from a critical data leakage bug by appending the original dataset to the training folds without deduplication, causing validation samples to leak into the training set. Additionally, there is a minor test-set peeking issue by applying one-hot encoding on the combined train and test datasets.
